title: NJ Economy
description: A modern Minecraft banking and economy mod featuring multiple accounts, money transfers, transaction history, refund requests and a configurable shop system.
body:
# EconomyMod

EconomyMod is a lightweight and customizable banking and economy mod for Minecraft servers. It provides players with a simple and intuitive way to manage their money, create bank accounts, transfer funds, and interact with a server-wide economy system.

---

## Why EconomyMod?

EconomyMod provides a simple but powerful banking system for multiplayer servers. Players can create multiple bank accounts, transfer money securely, and interact with an integrated economy through an intuitive GUI. It is designed for survival, roleplay, and community-driven servers that want more advanced money management than vanilla Minecraft offers.

---

## Features

### Bank Accounts

*   Create and manage personal bank accounts
*   View balances through an easy-to-use interface
*   Support for multiple accounts
*  Rename bank accounts
*  Delete bank accounts
*  Transfer money between own accounts

---

### Money Transfers

*   Send money to other players
*   Secure account-to-account transactions
*   Fast and simple transfer system

---

### User-Friendly GUI

*   Clean and intuitive menus
*   Easy account management
*   Quick access to banking features

---

### Server Economy

*   Fully configurable economy settings
*   Designed for multiplayer servers
*   Supports roleplay, survival, economy, and community-based servers

---

### Shop System

* Buy items through an integrated shop
* Sell supported items to the server
* Economy integration with bank accounts

---

## Requirements

*   Minecraft 1.21.11
*   Fabric Loader
*   Fabric API

---

## Supported Languages

*   English
*   German

Additional language translations are welcome. Community contributions help make the mod accessible to more players around the world.

---

## Current Status

⚠️ Alpha v0.1.1

EconomyMod is currently in active development.

Core banking features are functional, but bugs, balancing issues, and incomplete features may still be present.


⚠️ This is an early alpha release. Always create backups before using it on important worlds or servers.

---

## Feedback

Bug reports, suggestions, and feedback are always welcome and help improve the mod.

---

## Planned Features

* Invoice system
* Advanced shop integration
* Switch active bank accounts directly from the shop interface
* Advanced account permissions
* Additional administration tools
* Economy balancing options
* Server configuration options
* Account TAB completion
* Additional quality-of-life improvements

---

## Commands

- `/money` - Opens the banking GUI
- `/shop` - Opens the shop GUI

---
